'''Ashlarva''' is a [[Fire]] type [[Healer]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Ashlarva]] at 6 stars, and evolves into [[Charflutter]] at 18 stars.

==Overview==
Current Description: "After all that effort, Firecoil is finally a butterfly! But did the wings take on a leaf-like shape simply because Firecoil always hid under them?"

Firecoil is a gold rarity Tatari.

==Appearance==
TBA

== Evolution Trial ==
Firecoil's evolution trial unlocks once it reaches 18 stars. To evolve it into [[Charflutter]] you need to complete the following two tasks:
* Feed Firecoil to increase stats 3 times.
* Play [[Marathon Party]] (use x2000 skateboards) or [[Cozy Farm]] (use x4000 fertilizer).

== Trivia ==
* Prior to the update on 3/11/2026, its bio description said: "Firecoil wants to be friends with [[Skinklet]], but gets scared by Skinklet's water-spray performance."
* Prior to the update on 5/12/2026, its bio description said: "Firecoil's wings radiate intense heat and can burn any Tatari that comes too close, so it's best to keep some distance."
